crossRefs.note: Therefore Solomon sought to kill Jeroboam; but Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was…
There were also sodomites in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations which Yahweh drove out…
But if you turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments which I have set before you, and shall go and serve…
then I will pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have made holy…
Moreover all the chiefs of the priests, and the people, trespassed very greatly after all the abominations of the…
They abandoned Yahweh, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.
You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for…
“Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against you, cast your law behind their back, killed your prophets…
Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them. In the time of their trouble…
He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.
Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.
But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. Therefore he turned and became their enemy, and he himself fought…
“Your own wickedness will correct you, and your backsliding will rebuke you. Know therefore and see that it is an evil…
Thus Yahweh could no longer bear it, because of the evil of your doings, and because of the abominations which you have…
Because you have burned incense, and because you have sinned against Yahweh, and have not obeyed Yahweh’s voice, nor…
The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.

people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Rehoboam

translations.web: In the fifth year of king Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had trespassed against Yahweh,
translations.bsb: In the fifth year of Rehoboam’s reign, because they had been unfaithful to the LORD, Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the LORD,
translations.asv: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had trespassed against Jehovah,
